desc: Derive algorithm: closures are max-Cartesian-tree node intervals; `esc` recursion over parent barriers; stuck-case rule (hand-verified on both samples)

Performance review: O(N) monotonic stacks + numpy vectorization + single N-iteration `esc` loop; int64/prefix-sum safe for N=5·10⁵, A≤10⁹
DSU/level-merge fallback deemed unnecessary (Cartesian-tree argument validated)
